title: SourceInventory
description: Canonical source inventory. It preserves native/deterministic extraction provenance, separates raw text from LLM-assisted proposals, and links each derived sidecar to an access-controlled original. It is not an authorization record or a claim of anonymity. v2.1 (`schema: source_inventory_v2.1`) adds per-file sha256/size/page provenance, the worker that wrote the sidecar, the second-read channel and whether that reread was independent, the prior-archive digest source kind, and the top-level skipped_inputs[] ledger. Legacy `source_inventory_v2` inventories are read leniently by validate_structured_outputs.py (WARN, not FAIL).

patient_dir.description: Relative path or placeholder for <patient_dir> (e.g. "." or the patient-dir basename) — not an absolute path, so the inventory stays portable and never leaks a host filesystem path. All relative paths below resolve under this directory.

file_id.description: Stable id of this content unit (1:1 with the sidecar/MD), e.g. f001. N content units may share one source_id when a single upload yields multiple sidecars. See bucket-taxonomy.md §4.

source_id.description: Stable per-upload id, e.g. s001. 1:1 with an uploaded original in raw/; N content units may share it. Must equal the sidecar header FILE_ID.

original_path.description: De-identified raw handle (the Phase-1 de-id raw filename / source_id) recorded for audit; never used as an anchor. MUST be relative/de-identified — never a host-absolute path (/Users/...), cloud URL, email-attachment path, OR an identity-bearing upload basename (e.g. NOT '张测试-报告.pdf'). The verbatim upload filename is preserved only in raw/_FILENAME_MAPPING.md (inside raw/, excluded from export). source_inventory.json is a delivered/shared surface; the delivered-surface PII rescan (pii_rescan.py) hard-fails name/path leaks here.

raw_path.description: Protected relative path to the uploaded original. Access requires host authorization; the path is never an anchor or an export default. Null ONLY for source_kind=prior_archive_digest (there is no original in this packet; never write a placeholder pointer file).

page_range.description: Which pages of a multi-document source this content unit covers, e.g. "3-5". Null when the sidecar covers the whole file. Not a page label — see page_label.

bucket_path.description: Canonical bucket-relative path of the text-masked .md SIDECAR after Phase2 classification (clinical domain 01_…14_). The original is NOT copied here — it stays once in raw/ (see raw_path). Null before classification or for isolated unrelated files.

sidecar_path.description: Bucket-relative source-attributed, text-masked MD sidecar. The leading NN_ bucket segment is required.

modality.description: Orthogonal data-nature tag (independent of the clinical-domain bucket) driving ingest-parser dispatch. text=prose/OCR doc; image=imaging/scan stub; structured=tabular numeric report; omics_raw=parseable omics payload (VCF / annotated TSV / expression-methylation matrix); timeseries=wearable/PRO/longitudinal stream → longitudinal_observations.json; binary_other=opaque/unsupported binary, incl. BAM/FASTQ/DICOM/proprietary (stub + [INGESTION_BLOCKED], never silently dropped). See bucket-taxonomy.md §2 and ingest-adapters.md. Must equal the sidecar header MODALITY.

read_mode.description: Primary character-extraction mode. Model vision may assist but is never the only truth layer for high-risk fields. Must equal the sidecar header READ_MODE (hybrid_verified only when INDEPENDENT_REREAD is true).

raw_output_ref.description: Protected relative reference to preserved native/OCR character output; never a public export default.

high_risk_review_status.description: Status of the independent reread for identifiers, dates, drug/dose/frequency, laboratory values/units/ranges, stage, variants/VAF and accession numbers. passed_independent_reread requires independent_reread=true.

adapter.description: Format adapter used to make the source extractable and independently reviewable; it does not create a new clinical source. Must equal the sidecar header ADAPTER.

adapter_provenance.description: Short provenance such as decode_tool=sips;rotation=90 or pdftoppm pages=3. Temporary paths are allowed only as provenance, never as anchors.

persist.description: Whether this source file is selected for final archive/persist. Medical sources cited by formal outputs (timeline/case_text/review outputs/structured JSON source_refs) must be true; false is reserved for isolated unrelated/non-persisted sources.

sha256.description: sha256 of the uploaded original bytes (scripts/inventory_hash.py). Must equal the sidecar header SHA256. Null only for prior_archive_digest rows.

size_bytes.description: Byte size of the uploaded original. Null only for prior_archive_digest rows.

page_count.description: Pages in the original (image = 1, PDF = page count); null when not determinable.

page_label.description: Page label printed on the document, verbatim (e.g. "第2页，共3页" / "共1页/第1页"); a sidecar covering several printed pages lists every page's label in page order, separated by "；" ("第1页，共3页；第2页，共3页；第3页，共3页"); null when the document prints none. Parsed by scripts/page_completeness.py (parse_page_labels). Must equal the sidecar header PAGE_LABEL (header `none` ↔ null).

source_kind.description: upload = an original in this packet (raw_path required). prior_archive_digest = a digest of an earlier organize archive; usable for history only, never for current status or recommendations.

archive_ref.description: De-identified reference to the earlier archive: its patient_code, optionally @ its run date (PT-5A1F0C@2029-06-01). Never a path, a folder name or anything name-derived.

archive_generated_at.description: Date (or date-time) the earlier archive was generated.

sidecar_refs.description: Sidecar paths inside the earlier archive the digest was taken from.

superseded_by.description: Optional (upload reconciliation, 替换): the file_id of the later upload the user chose to prefer. The superseded sidecar stays in its bucket with every anchor intact (originals and anchors are never moved, remapped or deleted — upload-reconciliation.md); this is only a relation. Must name another files[] row.

second_read_channel.description: Channel of the second read: a fixed channel category, and for deterministic OCR the engine after a colon (`deterministic_ocr:<engine>`): text_layer, table_parser, deterministic_ocr:tesseract, barcode, human, llm_vision, prior_archive_sidecar (digest rows only), none. The engine part stays open; the categories are pinned (organizer-prompt-phase1-ocr.md §2). Must equal the sidecar header SECOND_READ_CHANNEL.

independent_reread.description: true only when the two read channels are of different categories AND neither is llm_vision. A model reading the image is never an independent reread.

skipped_inputs.description: Inputs that were received but not ingested, each with a reason. input_ref is a de-identified handle (scripts/inventory_hash.py `skip-NNN`), never the original upload name. Unsupported/corrupt formats are NOT skipped — they get a stub sidecar + [INGESTION_BLOCKED].

input_ref.description: A de-identified handle only: skip-NNN / in-NNN (scripts/inventory_hash.py) or the source_id sNNN of an ingested file later quarantined / excluded — never an upload name (a pinyin name would pass a filename-shape check).

worker_id.description: Id of the subagent/worker that wrote the sidecar (update_log workers[].worker_id). Reserved orchestrator names are rejected: the orchestrator never writes sidecars.
